summary: Cessna 172 (N4376Q) departed Rifle airport and struck high-tension wires ~3 miles east of RIL near Chair Bar Road, crashing inverted in rugged terrain; pilot and two passengers (including a minor child) seriously injured; Colorado River Fire Rescue responded; Garfield County SAR notified and on scene by 3:50 p.m.
location: Near Chair Bar Road, ~3 mi east of Rifle airport, near Silt
responding_agency: Colorado River Fire Rescue; Garfield County Search and Rescue; Garfield County Sheriff's Office
notes: Opened and verified by parent this run: NTSB CEN21LA119, 14:20 MST 2021-01-31; two adults flown by helicopter to St. Mary's Grand Junction, juvenile to Grand River Hospital then Children's Hospital Denver
